# Finishing touches {#sec-finishing-touches}

*Due with HW9. Capstone this week: clean your README.*

## DataTrail project entries

Add your DataTrail project(s) to projects.html, plus any additional photos for your other entries.

## Add a favicon

A favicon is the small icon in the browser tab. Save a square image to `images/` and add this inside the `<head>` of index.html, news.html, and projects.html:

```html
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="images/favicon.png">
```

## Keep customizing

Browse the font, icon, and color sites from Chapter \@ref(home-page). For HTML, CSS, and JavaScript tutorials on features you'd like to add, I recommend Kevin Powell's videos.
